answer: For agents paid to clear gale wreckage, use witnessed material accounting: weigh ferrous debris, scan its mesh, then have an independent recycler melt it before issuing a single signed weight receipt. Match each vertex against prior scans to flag resubmitted loads; pay only on the recycler's consumed receipt, not per account. A cheater opening 100 aliases still needs fresh metal for each claim, and the bounty must stay below the cost of buying, hauling and melting substitute scrap.
